notes: No state-by-state or country-level headcount, investment or tax data is published. The FY2026 Sustainability Report (fiscal year ended Jan 25, 2026) gives employees by region only as percentages (Americas 50.5%, APAC 16.4%, EMEA 20.5%, India 12.6%), recorded as published; no headcount was derived. The FY2026 10-K says NVIDIA had approximately 42,000 employees in 38 countries and owns and leases facilities 'throughout the U.S. and in various international locations, primarily in China, India, Israel, and Taiwan' (no counts). The ~6,000 Israel figure (up from ~4,700 a year earlier) is 'in the region' (in and around Israel) and sits inside EMEA, so it overlaps the EMEA percentage. Sites: HQ from the FY2026 10-K Item 2; Voyager/Endeavor, Hyderabad, Yokneam and the new Shanghai campus (opened in FY26) from the FY2026 Sustainability Report. Revenue by geography is in the records, not here.
